phases.name: Learn
phases.milestone: Complete a heuristic audit of the product surface and present 3 high-leverage UX gaps.

phases.name: Contribute
phases.milestone: Lead the redesign of one critical flow end-to-end (research, design, ship).

phases.name: Lead
phases.milestone: Present a 12-month design strategy for your surface and define the principles for AI-native UX patterns.

goals.title: Run heuristic + accessibility audit of the current product, with 15+ documented gaps
1:1 with all 9 key stakeholders, log notes per person
Establish weekly design critique with product and engineering leads
Lead the redesign of one critical user flow end-to-end
Ship 3 component-level upgrades to the design system
Run 5 user research sessions with current customers
Present a 12-month design strategy to leadership
Define and publish the principles for AI-native UX in this product

successDefinition: By Day 90, design is at the strategy table. PMs and engineers pull me in early. The product feels noticeably more polished. I've published the team's design principles. Customers can name something we shipped.

firstWeekActivities.title: Walk the current product end-to-end and screenshot every screen
1:1 with manager — agree on what 'great' looks like at 30 days
Read the most-cited customer research from the last 12 months
Audit the design system and note inconsistencies
Schedule recurring critique with PM and engineering
